title: Gray bath sheets
text: Gray bath sheets. Purchased these after we did a minor guest bath remodel.. the gray is dark and lovely.  They are heavy and big (as bath sheets should be) so they will fit a wide range of bodies.  They have washed and dried up nicely.  No complaints thus far. I purchased matching hand towels and wash clothes - all are thick and rich feeling and looking.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Towels - Luxurious Jumbo Bath Sheet 2 Pack - 600 GSM 100% Cotton Highly Absorbent and Quick Dry Extra Large Bath Towel - Super Soft Hotel Quality Towel (35 x 70 Inches, Beige)
features: LUXURY BATH SHEET – Our premium quality extra-large bath towel is sized at 35 x 70 Inches. Manufactured with 100% combed ring-spun cotton the bath towel is meant to sufficiently cater to all your needs.
TOPNOTCH QUALITY – The large bathroom towel is manufactured with 100% high-end ring-spun cotton to ensure reliability and durability that lasts long.
KEY FEATURES – Absorbent with a delicate feel; the combination makes the 600 GSM extra-large bathroom towel functional and luxurious. Maximum absorption with a soft comfort feels.
MACHINE WASHABLE – The bath towel is perfectly machine safe and can be easily washed with warm water and light soap. Dry the towels immediately.

QUALITY TAILORED JUST FOR YOU – To prevent unforeseen color discoloration, it is advised, to avoid the removal of the application of any form of cosmetics, facial creams, or scrubs directly with the towel.
